title: Agent Config Supported Keys
description: Documents all keys accepted by agent.config.update and returned by agent.config.get.response. Grouped by feature area. This file is informational — per-value validation is performed by the agent, not the envelope schema.

video.description: Controls the robot's video stream pipeline. Changes require an agent restart to take effect.

image_format.description: Output encoding format for video frames.

resolution.description: Output resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT string. Sets both image_width and image_height in the agent config.

image_encoding.description: Pixel encoding of raw frames from the camera source.

recording.description: Controls MCAP data recording. Reserved for future use.

ros_topics.description: Controls which ROS topics the agent subscribes to or publishes on. Changes require an agent restart. Topic names must be valid ROS names: allowed characters are [a-zA-Z0-9_/{}~], max 256 characters, no spaces, no trailing slash, no double slashes, no segment starting with a digit.

explicitRules: No path segment starting with a digit

ros.camera_raw_topic.description: ROS topic the agent subscribes to for raw (uncompressed) camera frames (sensor_msgs/Image). Used when image_format is Raw.

ros.camera_jpeg_topic.description: ROS topic the agent subscribes to for JPEG-compressed camera frames (sensor_msgs/CompressedImage). Used when image_format is Jpeg.

ros.nav_status_topic.description: ROS topic the agent subscribes to for navigation status feedback (std_msgs/String).

ros.cmd_vel_topic.description: ROS topic the agent publishes movement commands to (geometry_msgs/Twist).

ros.nav_goal_topic.description: ROS topic the agent publishes navigation goals to (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped).

ros.nav_cancel_topic.description: ROS topic the agent publishes navigation cancel signals to (std_msgs/Empty).

ros.nav_home_topic.description: ROS topic the agent publishes home signals to (std_msgs/Empty).
